children.value: Offing ships a Git pre-push hook that scans before you push, edit hooks for several agent hosts that check the files an agent just wrote, a Claude Code

hook that checks packages before an agent installs them, a Cursor project rule, and a GitHub Copilot instructions file that tell the agent to check a dependency before it is added. All of them stay offline and use only the lifecycle rules bundled with Offing.

is how an agent host asks Offing about a file it just wrote. The host sends its own hook payload as JSON on stdin; Offing runs one offline scan of the repository, keeps the findings in that file at or above the severity gate (default
to report nothing), and answers in the protocol the host understands. A hook only prints and exits: it never edits files.
A hook must never break the agent's session. An unknown host, a malformed payload, an event that is not a file write or edit, a scan error, and a scan that takes longer than ten seconds all exit

installs a Git pre-push hook that scans the repository before every push and blocks it when a finding reaches a severity you choose. It uses only local files; the scan never uses the network.

npx @velella/offing init --hooks --dry-run   # show the hook first
npx @velella/offing init --hooks             # install it
npx @velella/offing init --agents --hooks    # also add the agent instructions
. Only findings at or above the gate block the push (exit code 1). If Offing is not installed in the project, or a scan fails for another reason, the push is not blocked.

add Offing with three lines of config. Pin
to a release tag so everyone runs the same scanner:

repos:

    hooks:

A digest for your personal projects
re-scans the projects you register and prints only what is new since the last digest, so a new end-of-life date shows up once.

npx @velella/offing watch add ~/code/my-app     # register a project
npx @velella/offing watch list                  # show registered projects
npx @velella/offing watch                       # re-scan and print what changed
npx @velella/offing watch --weekly              # do nothing unless a week has passed since the last digest
npx @velella/offing watch remove ~/code/my-app  # stop watching
